crossRefs.note: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.

people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Ner
people.line: Father of Abner, King Saul's commander.

translations.web: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.
translations.bsb: So on that day all the troops and all Israel were convinced that the king had no part in the murder of Abner son of Ner.
translations.kjv: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.
translations.asv: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.
